key_findings: Glutamatergic neurons of the adolescent mouse superficial dorsal horn express more GR and MR mRNA than adjacent GABAergic neurons.

Acute corticosterone reduced mEPSC frequency/amplitude and mIPSC frequency in both cell types, lowering the E:I ratio; GR or MR antagonists did not prevent this, though eplerenone blocked the decrease in mEPSC amplitude.
